JUSTIFICATION & APPROVAL FOR OTHER THAN FULL AND OPEN COMPETITION for SIMPLIFIED ACQUISITIONS OVER THE MICROPURCHASE THRESHOLD (See FAR Part 2) UP TO SAT (See FAR 13.106-1) Date: 20 July, 2026 PR Number: ______________________

1. Nature and/or description of the item/service being procured and its intended use (include the anticipated cost): The National Park Service, Golden Gate National Recreation Area, identified a need for repair of a broken 8-inch water main at Fort Cronkhite on Saturday, July 18, 2026. The break is causing water to flow out of the water tanks faster than they can refill. NPS was able to isolate the broken section of pipe and turn off service downstream or all water service for the Marin Headlands and Fort Barry will be shut off when the tanks run dry. They are currently trying to isolate, but have not yet determined the size of the outage once they turn the section off. At a minimum, all buildings in Fort Cronkhite will lose water and bathrooms. This includes between 60-80 residents, park partners, and the public. At worse, the shutoff will affect the full Marin Headlands. This would shut off water and bathrooms to around 175 residents, park partners, and the public. We have proactively locked down all public bathrooms in Fort Cronkhite. It is urgent, both for public health and public safety, that these repairs be made as soon as possible.

2. Sole Source Justification rationale (Check one and explain below):

______ Only one responsible source.

__X__ Urgent and compelling circumstances exist. Include critical delivery or performance dates, and when you became aware of the requirement. Provide a specific statement of the impact on Government operations, financial or otherwise, if the required delivery or performance dates are not met. ______ Other _________________________________________________ Explain: The water break was discovered on Saturday, 18 July around 13:30. Water service was cut off to Fort Cronkhite once the water tank levels became dangerously low. Without water service, approximately 70 residents will not have drinking water or restrooms. Public bathrooms will be closed and water for the public at Rodeo Beach will be turned off. Water and bathrooms will be off for seven office buildings as well as the Nature Bridge campus. Nature Bridge has education programs for elementary-aged children. In all, the lack of restrooms and water will affect over 250 residents and staff and several thousand park visitors. This creates a public health and safety issue for the public, staff, and visitors. If the service is not repaired, water tanks for the Marin Headlands and Fort Last updated 6/2/2016 Baker would run dry. All water and sanitary services would be off and a syphon on the water system would be created. This would possibly damage the entire water system.

3. Market Research. Please explain the results or why one was not performed. State whether any other offers were received or anyone expressed interest:

There was insufficient time for full market research. Ghilotti Bros, Inc are a local heavy civil contractor who has the resources and knowledge to properly complete emergency repairs and the ability to mobilize quickly.
